question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A person who believes that all events are predetermined or subject to fate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Fatalist**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **fatalist **is someone who believes that all events are predetermined or subject to fate. (भाग्यवादी)

 
 
• **Example**:* As a fatalist, she believed that events were predetermined and beyond her control.*
 
 
 
• The word comes from the noun "
